description: This is a Java class defining a custom exception used in email campaign management within the Fineract platform. The exception indicates that an email campaign cannot be deleted unless it is in a 'Closed' state.

classes.name: EmailCampaignMustBeClosedToBeDeletedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that an email campaign must be in 'Closed' state before it can be deleted. It extends a platform-specific exception class to integrate with the Fineract error handling framework.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a resource ID, passing an error message and reference to the resource to the superclass.
